finding: Skilled staff shortage overtakes costs as Slovak firms' top concern
bullets: Slovak firms (n=239) rated skilled staff availability as the most pressing of the seven tested problems, scoring 6.64/10 — up 0.57 from 6.07 in the previous wave, now above the EA's 6.57, underscoring a growing operational bottleneck.

Costs of production or labour scored 6.62/10 (n=240), rising 0.43 from 6.19 in the previous wave, ranking second among the seven tested problems for Slovak firms — highlighting persistent inflationary pressures.
Regulation scored 6.10/10 (n=236), easing marginally by 0.08 from the previous wave, yet remaining above the EA average of 5.87 — suggesting lingering compliance burdens for firms.
chart_subtitle: Skilled staff scores 6.64/10, Slovak firms' top concern.
